name: lafengparrot

frame.origin: midpoint between the two hip_roll output axes at their height (hip plane, z=0)

conventions.zero_pose: standing: legs straight (all leg joints 0), wings level (+/-Y), neck straight up (yaw=0, pitch=0)
conventions.free_base: trunk is a floating base (6 free DOF: 3 pos + 3 rot)
conventions.single_source: this file + CAD/dims/dimensions.json + CAD/source/assembly/poses.py (instance placements); all three robot formats generate from these

links.name: trunk
links.note: hip_roll and wing servo BODIES ride on the trunk (rotor side drives the child link)

links.name: hip_L
links.note: N1 segment: hip_roll rotor side; carries the hip_pitch servo body; motor body in parent, rotor drives thigh

links.name: thigh_L
links.note: N2 segment: thigh beam from hip_pitch axis to knee axis; carries the knee servo body

links.name: shin_L
links.note: N3 segment: shin + fixed compound-rocker foot; no wheel or ankle; lowest sole contact is local z=-54

links.name: wing_L
links.note: wing arm + printed panel; wing servo body on trunk (shoulder)

links.name: neck_yaw
links.note: yaw rotor side: linkage + BOTH neck servo bodies (simplification: the yaw servo body is bolted to the base; putting it in the rotating link is a <3 g-equivalent, sub-mm CoM error; documented)

joints.name: knee_L
joints.note: positive = backward flexion from straight; limit [EST]

joints.name: neck_pitch
joints.note: nose-down -45 verified clear (36 mm above roof); limit [EST]

actuators.note: 50 Hz joint-target interface (microduck-style); kp/kv/armature are [EST] starting points for PPO tuning

imu_trunk.note: [EST] policy IMU site on the trunk; physical ICM-42688-P rides in the head (part of head link mass) at z~191.5

sole.note: Five fixed box facets approximate the CAD rocker underside. The 32 mm centre facet is flat at z=-54 mm; 4 mm toe and heel zones rise symmetrically to z=-52 mm. No wheel, axle, ankle, or extra actuator.

contact.self_collision: off by default; only soles contact (RL walking asset)

lump.note: the 105 g lump reconciles the 1.38 kg CAD solids to the 1.485 kg whole-robot mass used in the REV-B CoM (162.5 mm above floor)

generation: generate_meshes.py  -> meshes/visual/*.stl + meshes/collision/*_col.stl + inertials.json (CAD solids grouped by link)
verify.py           -> cross-format consistency check (joints, axes, order, limits)
notes_est: joint limits, kp/kv/armature, friction, imu site, lump distribution: [EST] starting values, tunable in RL
hip_roll axis at z=0, hip_pitch 42 below it, knee 84 below; soles at z=-138; neck pitch axis at 185
the later MuJoCo model (this MJCF) is the primary PPO asset and must stay the source of truth for training
